# mondoo_organization (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a new organization. To work in an organization you already have,
# look it up with the mondoo_organization data source instead.
resource "mondoo_organization" "acme" {
  name        = "ACME Corp"
  description = "Security posture for all of ACME's infrastructure."
  company     = "ACME Corp"

  annotations = {
    cost-center = "security"
  }
}

# Spaces belong to an organization. Put the new space in the organization
# created above.
resource "mondoo_space" "production" {
  name   = "Production"
  org_id = mondoo_organization.acme.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the space.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations for the organization as key-value pairs.
- `company` (String) Company name of the organization.
- `description` (String) Description of the organization.
- `id` (String) ID of the org. Must be globally unique. If the provider has a org configured and this field is empty, the provider org is used.

### Read-Only

- `mrn` (String) Mrn of the org.
